room_rent.note: No restriction on room rent or category

icu.note: No ICU room rent restriction stated for this plan

copayment.note: Zone-based 10% co-pay if hospitalized in higher zone than declared; optional Network Hospital Discount cover may introduce co-pay

sub_limits.display: Road ambulance 1% SI max ₹10k; health check-up every 2 yrs; modern treatments 50% SI (waivable)
sub_limits.note: Road ambulance capped at 1% of SI max INR 10,000; modern/new-age treatments capped at 50% SI unless Optional Cover 6 Advance Care opted; Smart Save optional cover adds disease sub-limits

ped_waiting.note: Can be reduced via Optional Cover 3 waiting period modification

specific_disease_waiting.note: Can be reduced via Optional Cover 3

maternity.note: Section 4 Maternity Benefit Wallet not applicable for Double Wallet plan; Optional Cover 9 Maternity & Newborn Baby Cover available

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of SI per claim-free year up to 100%; or No Claim Discount on premium as alternative

restoration.note: Sum Insured Back-up: 100% of SI once per policy period for related illness

domiciliary.note: Subject to 3-day minimum; certain conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.)

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH in NABH/NQAS accredited hospitals only

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post-hosp up to 5% of harvesting claim

ambulance.note: Road ambulance for emergency only; air ambulance covered up to SI under Section 3

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, oral chemo, HIFU etc. capped at 50% SI; Optional Cover 6 Advance Care upgrades to 100% SI

consumables.note: Optional Cover 1 Consumables Cover; not inbuilt

global_cover.note: Worldwide Coverage (Section 5) not applicable for Double Wallet plan

notable_exclusions: Consumables not covered inbuilt; tobacco-related oral/respiratory cancer excluded; hormone replacement therapy excluded; cosmetic surgery excluded
optional_riders: Consumables Cover, Network Hospital Discount, Waiting Period Modification, Sum Insured Multiplier, OPD Benefit, Advance Care (modern tx to 100%), Maternity & Newborn, Infertility, Daily Hospital Cash, Medical Equipment Cover
